title: NestJS module and ts-rest controller for one domain module

module.description: Domain module name, plural kebab-case (e.g. tasks, order-items).

fields.description: The same name:type list the schema layer was generated with; a trailing ? marks the field nullable, and string takes an optional length (title:string(500)).

toggleField.description: A boolean field from the schema layer to expose as a server-side toggle. Pass the same value to the schema, contract, service, controller, and hook layers. Omit when the module has none.
